steps.title: Open the home page
steps.narration: This is the home page, where a simulated market tape plays out live so you can see the underlying engine at work.
steps.point_out: A ticker box invites you to try SIM-BUYER, one of the built-in demo scenarios.

steps.title: Type in a simulated ticker
steps.narration: Enter SIM-BUYER — a scripted scenario built to show what buyer-controlled tape looks like.
steps.point_out: The ticker field now shows SIM-BUYER.

steps.title: Watch the tape settle into Buyer Control
steps.narration: Click Watch and the simulator replays the scripted tape. Within a few seconds it settles into Buyer Control, complete with a confidence score.
steps.point_out: The Tape State panel reads Buyer Control, and the event log confirms the tape state changed to buyer_control.

steps.title: Stop the run
steps.narration: Stop the simulation so we can try a second scenario.
steps.point_out: The controls reset, ready for a new ticker.

steps.title: Try a second scenario
steps.narration: This time, enter SIM-SELLER to see the opposite side of the tape.
steps.point_out: The ticker field now shows SIM-SELLER.

steps.title: Watch the tape settle into Seller Control
steps.narration: Click Watch again, and this scenario settles into Seller Control instead — proof the simulator can reproduce both sides of the tape.
steps.point_out: The Tape State panel now reads Seller Control, with its own confidence score and a matching log entry.

steps.title: Review the trading journal
steps.narration: Every simulated session is logged as a thesis in the journal, so you can look back later at what was watched and why.
steps.point_out: The journal list shows the SIM-BUYER and SIM-SELLER entries that were just recorded.

steps.title: Browse replay studies
steps.narration: The Studies page holds journaled measurements from tape replays — always labeled as measurements, never as a trading signal.
steps.point_out: The "Replay studies" heading and the reference-window and seeded-sim source options are visible.

steps.title: Check the performance ledger
steps.narration: Finally, the Performance page shows the simulated profit ledger for the founding baseline strategy.
steps.point_out: A banner makes clear every figure is simulated — assumed fees and slippage — not indicative of live results.

expect.text: simulated — assumed fees/slippage — not indicative of live results
